title: H3 ref2v fails: comfy-aimdo file read error 1450 (HostBuffer.read_file_slice) is not caught by the MPI-1024 fallback
description: Windows ERROR_NO_SYSTEM_RESOURCES on aimdo's unbuffered reads of the 25 GB H3 text encoder; upstream open, workaround --disable-dynamic-vram, which the MPI-1024 fallback only triggers on allocation faults.
